payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped eachTenant({includeArchived?,filter?,payload?}) from @fricken/server — builds a FrickRecurringJob.resolveTargets that fans out one enqueue per ledger tenant per tick (active-only by default). App supplies just predicate/payload, not the loop. 4 tests; full server suite 775 green. aquariusyacht can replace listCompanyTenantIds-based per-tenant scheduling.
